exposes_tools.name: market.quote
exposes_tools.description: Current price of one asset. Callers name the asset AND its venue; which source answers a venue, at which URL, is chosen by this plugin. Only the CRYPTO venue has a source today, so a US, HK or CN name is answered as unpriceable.

asset.description: Asset name. Bare (`BTC`) means the crypto venue; a venue-qualified name is `<VENUE>:<SYMBOL>` over CRYPTO, US, HK and CN (`CRYPTO:BTC`, `US:NVDA`, `HK:1810`, `CN:600519`). A prefix counts only with the colon, so `USNVDA` is a crypto name. Only the CRYPTO venue has a price source today.

exposes_tools.name: market.holdings.set
exposes_tools.description: Record how much of an asset this Track holds. Replaces any existing quantity for that asset; 0 removes it. Records only — the price is fetched by the plugin's own refresh, which this call wakes. An asset on a venue with no source yet (US, HK, CN) is recorded but stays unpriced, and a portfolio holding one adds no history points until a source for that venue lands.

asset.description: Asset name. Bare (`BTC`) means the crypto venue; a venue-qualified name is `<VENUE>:<SYMBOL>` over CRYPTO, US, HK and CN (`CRYPTO:BTC`, `US:NVDA`, `HK:1810`, `CN:600519`). A prefix counts only with the colon, so `USNVDA` is a crypto name. Only the CRYPTO venue has a price source today.

quantity.description: How much is held. 0 removes the holding.

exposes_tools.name: market.holdings.list
exposes_tools.description: What this Track currently holds, with the venue, latest price and value of each.

quote.description: The asset every holding is priced in

binance_endpoint.description: Base URL of the Binance market-data source. api.binance.com is geo-restricted from some hosts; data-api.binance.vision serves the same /api/v3 paths with no key.
